# Example reports and templates {#sec-resources}

These files provide examples to learn from and starting points for your own crime-mapping projects. You can view a finished report in your browser, or download its Quarto or R source file to see how the text and R code produce the report.

The completed scripts developed in the chapters are available in @sec-chapter-code, including the Medellín map report from @sec-reports.

::: {.resource-downloads}

| Resource description | Source | Output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Medellín homicides: map.** An example of how to create a short report in Quarto, including explanatory text, a density map, a figure caption and a cross-reference. More details in @sec-reports. | [Download QMD](../resources/reports/medellin_homicides_map.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm download="medellin_homicides_map.qmd" data-external="1" aria-label="Download Medellín map report source (QMD)"} | [Download HTML](../resources/reports/medellin_homicides_map.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm download="medellin_homicides_map.html" data-external="1" aria-label="Download Medellín map report output (HTML)"} |
| **Medellín homicides: table.** An example of how to create a short report in Quarto, including a table and associated explanatory text. More details in @sec-reports and @sec-no-maps. | [Download QMD](../resources/reports/medellin_homicides_table.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm download="medellin_homicides_table.qmd" data-external="1" aria-label="Download Medellín table report source (QMD)"} | [Download HTML](../resources/reports/medellin_homicides_table.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm download="medellin_homicides_table.html" data-external="1" aria-label="Download Medellín table report output (HTML)"} |
| **Fire hotspots in Edmonton.** An example of how to create a longer report in Quarto about demand for fire and rescue services. | [Download QMD](../resources/reports/edmonton_fire_rescue_demand.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm download="edmonton_fire_rescue_demand.qmd" data-external="1" aria-label="Download Edmonton report source (QMD)"} | [Download HTML](../resources/reports/edmonton_fire_rescue_demand.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm download="edmonton_fire_rescue_demand.html" data-external="1" aria-label="Download Edmonton report output (HTML)"} |
| **Illegal waste dumping in Yarra.** An example of how to create a longer report in Quarto comparing waste dumping between suburbs. | [Download QMD](../resources/reports/yarra_waste_dumping.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm download="yarra_waste_dumping.qmd" data-external="1" aria-label="Download Yarra report source (QMD)"} | [Download PDF](../resources/reports/yarra_waste_dumping.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm download="yarra_waste_dumping.pdf" data-external="1" aria-label="Download Yarra report output (PDF)"} |

:::

To use a source file or template, save it in the relevant folder of your crime mapping workspace and open it in Positron. Keep original downloaded data in `data/raw/`, as explained in @sec-create-project.
